name: doc-place
description: Recommend where a project document belongs in the OKF workspace before writing. Returns a structured placement decision: extend an existing document, add to an existing /projects/<slug>/ folder, or create a new kebab-case folder (never a task UUID). Call this before creating a new project folder. Does not write — follow up with doc-write at the recommended path.

inputs.intent: string? (what the document is for — used with title to suggest a slug)
inputs.title: string? (task or work title — preferred source for the suggested slug hint)
inputs.proposed_slug: string? (LLM-chosen kebab-case folder name to validate / match)
inputs.leaf: string? (optional document leaf, e.g. brief.md — defaults to brief.md)
inputs.prefer_new_folder: boolean? (when true, allocate a unique new folder even if a match exists)

outputs.catalog: array of {slug, directory_prefix, document_count, sample_paths, sample_titles}
